$comment: Posts taken off the site on purpose, applied by scripts/migrate/webflow-to-sanity.mjs (README.md section 13): the migration leaves each one out of the dataset, and stops if a slug is not a published post in the Webflow export, if migration/seo-intentional-changes.json `removed` does not hold the same paths and redirects, or if any remaining document still links to a removed post. Each removed URL 301s in one hop to `redirect` (web/src/config/redirects.mjs, LEGACY_REDIRECTS), and so does its old /blog/ path. Neither post is Tier 1.
